subject: Partial-duty return: ergonomic workstation request + shadow coverage plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_occonnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partial-duty return: ergonomic workstation request + shadow coverage plan

Tessa / Grace / Neha,

Thanks again for the update last week. Tessa — super glad to hear you're planning to start a phased return. To get ahead of scheduling and equipment, can you confirm your target return date and the number of hours per week you think you can manage initially?

My immediate asks:
- Tessa: please attach any recent documentation from your provider (we'll need this for HR).
- Grace/Neha: HR intake and occupational health assessment — can you advise timing and whether we should engage an external vendor for an ergonomic assessment for a home setup?
- I'll draft a temporary coverage matrix for product reviews and PR triage (2 weeks overlap + partial shadowing).

Goal: a concrete 4-week pilot that balances Tessa's capacity, provides ergonomic equipment, and ensures coverage of high-priority tasks.

I can be flexible on start date depending on the OH recommendation.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 12:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial-duty return: ergonomic workstation request + shadow coverage plan

On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 8:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Tessa / Grace / Neha,
> 
> Thanks again for the update last week...

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the check-in. I'm aiming to start a phased return the week of Aug 17. Current recommendation from my physician is:
- Max 4 hours/day, 3 days/week for the first two weeks (total 12 hrs/wk)
- Gradual increase to 20 hrs/wk over weeks 3-6 depending on tolerance

I've attached the provider note (doctor_note_20260802.pdf) which outlines the limitations. Key point: sustained typing >45 minutes is not advised without additional ergonomic support (lap rests, split keyboard, height-adjustable desk).

I can do core synchronous items (team stand-ups, postmortems) and light async work (reviews, strategic docs). I'll need a clear list of high-priority responsibilities and someone to shadow/handoff live for the first two weeks.

Thanks for coordinating,
Tessa
Product Manager

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial-duty return: ergonomic workstation request + shadow coverage plan

On Mon, Aug 3, 2026 at 12:21 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Marcus — appreciate the check-in...

Thanks for the note and the provider document, Tessa — received. A few next steps from HR/OH perspective:
- Neha and I will open an accommodation case in ADP WorkLife and upload the doctor's note.
- We'll schedule an Occupational Health (external) phone consult this week to confirm equipment recommendations and any functional capacity notes. OH will email directly (cc'd: oh@slumberhealth.com).
- Marcus: please share the proposed coverage matrix (who will shadow, who takes ownership of urgent PRs) so we can log expected FTE adjustments in the accommodation plan.

Also, we'll prepare an accommodation agreement for signature. If OH recommends equipment that requires procurement, we'll route to IT/vendor procurement and mark it expedited.

Grace
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_occonnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial-duty return: ergonomic workstation request + shadow coverage plan

Team — drafting the temporary coverage plan attached (proposed_coverage_matrix.xlsx). High-level summary below for OH/HR and for Tessa to confirm it's acceptable:

Week 1-2 (Aug 17-28):
- Tessa: 3 days / week, up to 4 hrs/day. Focus: roadmap prioritization, synchronous planning, and decision sign-offs. No heavy PRs or incident ownership.
- Shadow: Neha will cover PR triage in mornings (9–11am PT) and hand-off to Liam (eng team) for escalation follow-through. I'll handle strategic stakeholder updates.
- Documentation: All design reviews to have a 'read-ahead' doc to reduce live screen time for Tessa.

Week 3-6 ramp to 20 hrs/wk: add one async code review block and return of low-latency inbox duties.

Equipment request (per Tessa's note):
- Height-adjustable desk mat + external monitor arm
- Split ergonomic keyboard + padded wrist rest
- Hoteling kit for occasional office visits (small lumbar pillow)

I will also block shadow sessions on our calendars (30–45m) so we have overlap. Grace/Neha — please advise on procurement timeline for the listed items; if OH approves vendor recommendations, I'll route purchase requests.

Marcus

From: Occupational Health <oh@slumberhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial-duty return: ergonomic workstation request + shadow coverage plan

Hi all — thanks for the referral and the provider note. Preliminary recommendations after a chart review:
- Approve phased return as proposed: 4 hrs/day x 3 days/week for 2 weeks, then gradual increase.
- Approved equipment (home): height-adjustable laptop riser, external 24" monitor (on arm), split keyboard, vertical mouse option, gel wrist rests.
- If the employee plans to work from office occasionally, provide an ergonomic chair with lumbar support and a sit-stand desk.

Notes for HR: recommend a 6-week follow-up check (telephonic) to confirm tolerance and update any functional limitations. No contraindications to the proposed coverage matrix.

We can provide a simple workstation spec sheet for procurement (see attached workstation_spec_sheet.pdf). If you'd like, we can also set up a 20–30 minute virtual ergonomic coaching session the first week (helpful for keyboard/mouse repositioning).

— OH Case Manager

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_occonnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partial-duty return: ergonomic workstation request + shadow coverage plan

Thanks — this is great and exactly what we needed.

Tessa: OH approved the equipment and the phased schedule. Grace/Neha — can you please open the DocuSign accommodation agreement and route to Tessa today? Link attached: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/AccomAgreement/987654

Next operational steps:
- Grace: finalize ADP case and send the accommodation agreement for signature (accommodation_agreement_docusign.pdf).
- Neha: place expedited procurement request with IT for the items in workstation_spec_sheet.pdf; please cc: workstation-vendor@ergotools.com for quotes.
- Marcus: I'll own the shadow schedule and will forward calendar invites for the 30–45m overlap sessions.

Tessa — please reply here when you've signed and we'll confirm the Aug 17 start date and the 1st-week shadow blocks.

Thanks team — one small thing to add: let's keep all sensitive medical attachments to the HR case folder only (Grace/Neha).

Marcus
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
